data_description.important_note: This dataset from NASA's MODIS Active Fire Product (MCD14DL) detects thermal anomalies including volcanic eruptions, lava flows, and fumarolic activity. The thermal detection algorithm is sensitive to both flaming and smoldering volcanic thermal emissions. Volcanic thermal anomalies can be distinguished from wildfires by spatial persistence, location near known volcanic centers, and temporal patterns.
analytical_capabilities: Active volcano eruption detection and monitoring
Eruption onset and cessation timing analysis

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Fire Radiative Power (FRP) in megawatts (MW) and brightness temperature in Kelvin; volcanic thermal anomalies typically show sustained elevated FRP at fixed locations.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Filter thermal detections by proximity to known volcanic centers and temporal persistence to isolate volcanic signals from wildfire noise; combine with volcano location databases for validation.

data_description.data_source: NASA MODIS Active Fire Product (MCD14DL) via Google Earth Engine
